package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeSubject = "planner.onboarding-path.outcome.v1"
	TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeSchema  = "planner-onboarding-path-outcome.v1"
	TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeVersion = 1
	TeacherOnboardingPathReady          = "PATH_READY"
	TeacherOnboardingPathActiveExists   = "ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS"
	TeacherOnboardingPathStateChanged   = "STATE_CHANGED"
)

var ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome = errors.New("invalid teacher onboarding path outcome")

// TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome is the bounded Planner terminal fact. It never
// carries graph, profile, provider, raw error, or browser/UI identifiers.
type TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome struct {
	EventID        string
	EventType      string
	CorrelationID  string
	CausationID    string
	StudentID      string
	OccurredAt     time.Time
	ExecutionID    string
	HandoffID      string
	DialogID       string
	TeacherJobID   string
	Status         string
	CourseID       string
	LearningPathID string
	FirstLessonID  string
}

type TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord struct {
	Outcome           TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
	PersonalTeacherID string
	Body              string
	AcceptedAt        time.Time
	DialogMessageID   string
	DeliveredAt       *time.Time
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome(input TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome) (TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome, error) {
	input.EventID = strings.TrimSpace(input.EventID)
	input.EventType = strings.TrimSpace(input.EventType)
	input.CorrelationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CorrelationID)
	input.CausationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CausationID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.ExecutionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ExecutionID)
	input.HandoffID = strings.TrimSpace(input.HandoffID)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.TeacherJobID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TeacherJobID)
	input.Status = strings.TrimSpace(input.Status)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.LearningPathID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningPathID)
	input.FirstLessonID = strings.TrimSpace(input.FirstLessonID)
	input.OccurredAt = input.OccurredAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)

	if input.EventType != TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeSubject ||
		!validUUID(input.EventID) || !validUUID(input.CorrelationID) || !validUUID(input.CausationID) ||
		!validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.ExecutionID) || !validUUID(input.HandoffID) ||
		!validUUID(input.DialogID) || !validUUID(input.TeacherJobID) || input.OccurredAt.IsZero() ||
		input.CorrelationID != input.ExecutionID || input.CausationID != input.HandoffID {
		return TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
	}

	switch input.Status {
	case TeacherOnboardingPathReady:
		if !validUUID(input.CourseID) || !validUUID(input.LearningPathID) || !validUUID(input.FirstLessonID) {
			return TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
		}
	case TeacherOnboardingPathActiveExists, TeacherOnboardingPathStateChanged:
		if input.CourseID != "" || input.LearningPathID != "" || input.FirstLessonID != "" {
			return TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
		}
	default:
		return TeacherOnboardingPathOutcome{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
	}
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord(input TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord) (TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord, error) {
	outcome, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome(input.Outcome)
	if err != nil {
		return TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, err
	}
	input.Outcome = outcome
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.Body = strings.TrimSpace(input.Body)
	input.DialogMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogMessageID)
	input.AcceptedAt = input.AcceptedAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	if !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) || input.Body == "" || len([]rune(input.Body)) > 2000 || input.AcceptedAt.IsZero() {
		return TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
	}
	if input.DeliveredAt == nil {
		if input.DialogMessageID != "" {
			return TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
		}
	} else {
		deliveredAt := input.DeliveredAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
		if !validUUID(input.DialogMessageID) || deliveredAt.Before(input.AcceptedAt) {
			return TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeRecord{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboardingPathOutcome
		}
		input.DeliveredAt = &deliveredAt
	}
	return input, nil
}

func TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeBody(locale, status string) string {
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(locale)), "en") {
		switch status {
		case TeacherOnboardingPathReady:
			return "Your learning path is ready. The first lesson is available in Learning Home."
		case TeacherOnboardingPathActiveExists:
			return "Your existing learning path remains active. No new path was created."
		default:
			return "Your onboarding state changed before the path was ready. Refresh your status to continue."
		}
	}
	switch status {
	case TeacherOnboardingPathReady:
		return "Ваш учебный путь готов. Первый урок доступен на главной странице обучения."
	case TeacherOnboardingPathActiveExists:
		return "Ваш существующий учебный путь остаётся активным. Новый путь не создавался."
	default:
		return "Состояние онбординга изменилось до готовности пути. Обновите статус, чтобы продолжить."
	}
}
